question:
With reference to ‘Saila dance’ consider the following statements and select the correct option.

a) A group comprising of male performers.

b) The dance is performed with bamboo sticks.

c) It is performed after the cutting of crops.
solution:
The correct answer is __**a, b, c**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Saila dance** is performed by a group comprising of male performers.
